input.summary: Name Clear Capital's affiliates and contractors as licensees in § 4(c), label the licence irrevocable, and confirm transfer to a successor in a merger or acquisition.
input.comment: [Playbook] We named our Affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf as licensees and confirmed the licence is irrevocable and transferable to a successor in a merger or acquisition, so that operational use across our group does not depend on inferring it from the sublicensing right. This is a drafting clarification of the existing bargain, not a change in scope; if you prefer, we can instead add affiliates on written notice.

ops.oldText: Contractor hereby grants to Company a royalty-free, non- exclusive perpetual license (including the right to grant a sublicense)
ops.newText: Contractor hereby grants to Company, its Affiliates and its contractors acting on its behalf a royalty-free, non-exclusive, irrevocable, perpetual license (including the right to grant a sublicense and the right to transfer this license to a successor in a merger or acquisition)
